cell-compartments.alt: Left, an animal cell divided by membranes: a nucleus holding the DNA, the endoplasmic reticulum, the Golgi, an acidic lysosome at about pH 5 inside cytosol at about pH 7.2, and a mitochondrion whose inner membrane is deeply folded. Right, a prokaryotic cell with no membrane-bound organelles; its DNA sits in an unenclosed nucleoid region and ribosomes are scattered through the cytoplasm.
